canon-avatar:pandora.x: Lush, habitable exomoon of the gas giant Polyphemus in the Alpha Centauri A system; home of the Na’vi and source of unobtanium.

67p-churyumov.x: Jupiter-family comet orbited by ESA’s Rosetta spacecraft and touched down upon by the Philae lander in November 2014.

teegarden-star.x: Earth-mass exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of an ultra-cool red dwarf 12.5 light-years from Earth, confirmed in 2024.

gaia-2952868119987647744.x: Bright orange giant star marking the northern boundary of Canis Major.

gaia-2098237656065233792.x: Northern binary pair of the famous "Double Double" quadruple star system.
gaia-2098237656065233792.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

gaia-3736865265441207424.x: Bright yellow giant star traditionally regarded as herald of the grape harvest in classical times.
gaia-3736865265441207424.a: International Astronomical Union (IAU) / Hipparcos / Gaia DR3

carina-nebula.x: Vast star-forming complex and home of luminous blue variable Eta Carinae.
